results.summary: Three packages were upgraded in requirements.txt: Jinja2 from 2.11.2 to 3.1.6, requests from 2.25.1 to 2.33.0, and urllib3 from 1.26.18 to 2.8.0. MarkupSafe was also bumped from 2.0.1 to 3.0.2 to satisfy Jinja2 3.x's dependency. One code fix was required: in shop/render.py the imports of Markup and escape were changed from the jinja2 package to markupsafe, where they now live in Jinja2 3.x. shop/tax.py required no changes. All 4 tests pass.
